svg.title: Robot Factory and Arena system overview
svg.desc: Left-to-right architecture: experiment and search feed policy providers, providers emit tool calls into a deterministic execution core, and sealed evidence reaches an independent verifier. Langfuse and Visualizer are secondary observation projections.
